<thought>We need to obtain the precursors for the target molecule (acetophenone, SMILES CC(=O)c1ccccc1) using the retrosynthetic template that was identified in the search results. The search returned several matching templates; the first one (reaction_id 23352) appears to correspond to a Friedel‑Crafts acylation, converting a bromobenzene and an acyl chloride into the acetophenone product. I will try to apply this template (using its reaction_id as the template identifier) to the target molecule to generate the possible precursor sets.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccccc1",
    "template_id": "23352"
}</action_input>
